_about: Auto Mailing thresholds, in percentage points: a fund is flagged when its return for the period is below its category average (its sector average for Sectoral/Thematic) by MORE than this. 12M = 1 year. Email recipients, the sender and the Brevo API key are NOT kept here (this repository is public): they are the secrets ALERT_RECIPIENTS, BREVO_SENDER_EMAIL, BREVO_SENDER_NAME and BREVO_API_KEY, in .env locally and in GitHub Actions secrets.
